Stop asking RFIs on phone calls.

A question asked on a call is forgotten by Friday. In Plavyn every RFI is written down, sent to the right consultant with a due date, and the answer stays on record for the next person on site.

Cover blocks: 5 checks before the pour.

Missing cover shows up years later as rusted bars and spalling concrete. Two minutes with a tape before you call for concrete saves that.

Save this for your next slab, and send it to your site supervisor.

No scale rule? Measure on the sheet.

Set the scale from one known length, tap two points, and read it in metres and feet-inches together. Right on site, no printout.

Curing concrete: how many days?

IS 456: keep exposed surfaces moist for at least 7 days with OPC, 10 days with blended cements or mineral admixtures, and longer in hot, dry weather. Follow your spec, and record when curing started.

Save this for your next pour.
